dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp, high-contrast pale margins along the outer vanes of the folded primaries and secondaries against darker feather centers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Distinct transition where the uniform light plumage of the head meets the heavily scalloped texture of the upper mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Broad, dark subterminal band visible on the dorsal surface of the rectrices.
